label: Compliance Evidence Pro
summary: Advanced evidence cases, control mappings, review assignments and reproducible exports for internal or external assessments. Reports state their sources and limitations and do not claim regulatory certification from a checklist.
core_boundary: Core retains baseline compliance, security controls, audit integrity, retention and authorized export. This module organizes optional assessment evidence; it cannot change mandatory policy, create a second authoritative audit history or declare legal compliance automatically.
acceptance: Map every assessment statement to a source, capture time, scope, control version and review status.
Generate bounded redacted exports with explicit access and evidence-retention policy.
Distinguish missing evidence, failed controls, accepted exceptions and verified observations.
Test tampered source references, changed authority and retention/hold conflicts without overwriting canonical audit.
Keep baseline security/audit access available after module removal and preserve agreed independent evidence references.
